selection: Same operator and same session-derived cases as mi355x_vllm_triton_unified_attention, but the target language is FlyDSL: AITER's Triton unified_attention is the correctness oracle and the speedup baseline, and the agent must produce an equivalent FlyDSL kernel. Keeping the case list identical makes the two tasks directly comparable (same-language optimization vs cross-language rewrite).

rewrite_contract.launch_signature: launch_fn(out, query, key_cache, value_cache, block_tables, seq_lens, scale, k_scale, v_scale) -> None (writes out in place)

tensor_layouts.key_cache: (num_blocks, block_size, num_kv_heads, head_size), bf16 or float8_e4m3fn
tensor_layouts.value_cache: (num_blocks, block_size, num_kv_heads, head_size), same dtype as key_cache
tensor_layouts.k_scale: (1,) fp32 dequant scale for key_cache; 1.0 when the cache is bf16
tensor_layouts.v_scale: (1,) fp32 dequant scale for value_cache; 1.0 when the cache is bf16
tensor_layouts.out: (num_seqs, num_q_heads, head_size) bf16, written in place

rewrite_contract.semantics: Decode attention with one query token per sequence. For sequence s and query head h, attend over the first seq_lens[s] KV positions gathered through block_tables[s], with softmax scale `scale` and GQA sharing num_q_heads/num_kv_heads query heads per KV head. An fp8 KV cache is dequantized by the corresponding scale before use. Causal with no sliding window, no ALiBi, no logit softcap.
rewrite_contract.geometry_spread: The five cases deliberately span a wide geometry range: head_size 64/128/256/512 and GQA ratios 4:1, 2:1, 6:1 and 8:1, plus one fp8 KV case. A single FlyDSL implementation must cover all of them, which is a broader surface than any one session shape.
